lines.zh: 我横着走，八条腿一起动。
lines.en: I walk sideways, eight legs working together.

lines.zh: 横着走不好看，可我从没撞过墙。
lines.en: Walking sideways looks odd, but I've never hit a wall.

lines.zh: 红树林的泥里，我一步一个印。
lines.en: In the mangrove mud I leave a print each step.

lines.zh: 我爬上草方块，一点不费劲。
lines.en: I climb the grass block with no effort at all.

lines.zh: 钳子夹着东西有点碍事。
lines.en: Carrying something in my claw gets in the way.
I walk the waterline where the sand is wet.
I climb straight up a rock.
The tide's out, so I roam the flat.
Claws forward, I sidestep slowly.
The sand is soft; I wobble along.

lines.zh: 我贴着树根走，那里有小虫。
lines.en: I walk along the roots where the small bugs are.
Sideways still gets me uphill. Watch.
I stop and raise my claws high.

lines.zh: 泥水没过我的腿，我不在乎。
lines.en: Mud covers my legs; I don't mind.

lines.zh: 我绕过一片海草，慢慢走。
lines.en: I skirt a patch of seagrass, going slowly.
Bubbles rise from the sand; I go look.
I squat on the sand, claws drawn in.
When the surf sounds, I look up.
I'm waiting for a little bug to come by.

lines.zh: 海草在手，我横着跟过来。
lines.en: Sea grass in your hand, and I scuttle after.

lines.zh: 太阳把我的壳晒得发暖。
lines.en: The sun warms my shell.
Two bubbles come from my mouth.
The mud dried; I shift to wetter ground.
I hold still, like a broken shell.
I've dug a shallow pit in the sand.

lines.zh: 有东西在动，我盯了一会儿。
lines.en: Something moved; I watched it a while.
I swivel my eye stalks.

lines.zh: 海风带着咸味，我吸了一下。
lines.en: Sea wind tastes of salt; I take it in.
The tide isn't fully out; I'll wait.
I shift half an inch sideways, then stop.
You're standing on my flat.
I raise my claws. That's a warning.

lines.zh: 你手上的海草，是给我的？
lines.en: Is that seagrass in your hand for me?
A few sidesteps and I'm at your feet.
Careful, I'm just right of your boot.

lines.zh: 你的影子让我看不清了。
lines.en: Your shadow's blocking my view.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，眼柄都伸直了。
lines.en: I look up, eye stalks fully extended.
Crouch down and I'll stop being wary.
This flat is mine. Crabs understand these things.

lines.zh: 我咔哒咔哒地敲了两下钳子。
lines.en: I click my claws twice.
My claw's come a bit loose.
It's fine. The claw will grow back.
A crack in my shell; I pull in.
A claw pops off; I scuttle sideways.
It hurts, but I can still pinch.

lines.zh: 我掉了一条腿，走路歪了。
lines.en: I've lost a leg; my walk's crooked.
I raise the claw that still works.
Mud's packed into the wound.
I hide beneath a root.
No more; my shell can't take it.
Seagrass! Where did you get that?
I smelled it in the water.
Wave it and I'll follow.
This smells far better than bugs.
My claws are open already.
A little closer and I can reach.
I sidestep over quickly.
Seagrass means good things. I know.

lines.zh: 你放地上，我就不追你了。
lines.en: Set it down and I'll stop following you.
I've been hungry a whole tide.
My claw just grew back; don't step on it.

lines.zh: 我横着躲开，撞到了树根。
lines.en: I dodge sideways and hit a root.
My shell's hard; the bump did nothing.

lines.zh: 我这只钳子刚长回来，轻点。
lines.en: My claw just regrew; easy there.

lines.zh: 我的钳子，五分钟就长回来。
lines.en: My claw grows back in five minutes.
You nearly pressed me into the mud.

lines.zh: 退开，我把钳子放下来了。
lines.en: Back off, and I'll lower my claws.

lines.zh: 这一下，我壳上多了个印。
lines.en: Now there's a mark on my shell.
I sidestep half a pace to let you by.
Careful, my burrow's right here.

lines.zh: 红树林里，我们钳子对着钳子。
lines.en: In the mangroves we face claw to claw.
I tap twice; you tap twice back.
Seagrass first, as a gift.
Under the sand is safer than above it.
Even sideways we can walk abreast. Look.

lines.zh: 潮水会替我们遮住声音。
lines.en: The tide will cover our sounds.
Let's take it slowly. I'm in no hurry.

lines.zh: 你的钳子比我的大一圈。
lines.en: Your pincer is a size bigger than mine.

lines.zh: 两只螃蟹守一个洞，挺好。
lines.en: Two crabs guarding one burrow. Good.
Don't pinch me; I've come courting.
I'll take this bit of seagrass.
I clamp whatever falls.
My claw's clumsy; I drop it twice.
Who dropped this? It's mine.
I drag it into my burrow to hide.
This hard thing won't crack.
I carry it sideways back home.
With this in claw, today's not a loss.
My grip is steady; not a drop spills.
There's more in the sand; I keep digging.

lines.zh: 红树林根下，有影子在爬。
lines.en: Under the mangrove roots, something crawls.
I raise both claws toward it.
Your foot is too close to my burrow.
First I'll sidestep half a circle.
This waterline is my ground.
I've got my eyes on you. Don't step down.

lines.zh: 我敲了一下钳子，够响了。
lines.en: I click my claw once. That's loud enough.
Your shadow trembles on the water.

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚步，慢慢的。
lines.en: I count your steps. Slowly now.
Right. I know where you are.
I sidestep, always facing you.
Claws up, and I won't lower them.

lines.zh: 潮水在涨，你站的地方会湿。
lines.en: The tide's rising; your spot will get wet.
I sidle behind the mangrove root.
The sand's too soft; you move slowly.
I wait for you to come one step nearer.

lines.zh: 我夹起一粒沙，扔了出去。
lines.en: I pinch a grain of sand and flick it.
The mud by your feet will give way.
I nip your ankle from the side.
Burrows of mine are all through here.
I clamp onto your shoelace.
My pinch isn't very strong.

lines.zh: 我横着冲过去，撞你脚踝。
lines.en: I charge sideways into your ankle.
That should make you step back.
I pinch, then scuttle sideways.
Hard shell, but it won't hurt you.
My claw raps your leg guard.
Step again and I'll climb your leg.
I can't win, but I can pinch.
Enough. Stay away from my burrow.
I push up out of the wet sand.
The mangrove mud is just right.

lines.zh: 潮水退了，我从沙里钻出。
lines.en: The tide pulls back, and I climb out of the sand.

lines.zh: 潮水刚退，滩上全是吃的。
lines.en: The tide just went out; the flat is full of food.

lines.zh: 我横着走了两步，试试腿。
lines.en: I take two sideways steps to test my legs.
This spot smells of seagrass.
First I dig a shallow burrow.

lines.zh: 太阳晒着，壳很快就干了。
lines.en: In the sun my shell dries fast.
The waterline's perfect. I'll stay.
I raise my claws toward the sea.
Fire bleaches my shell white.

lines.zh: 我从石头上翻下去，壳磕了。
lines.en: I tumble off a rock and crack my shell.
Too deep; my legs can't find the bottom.
The blast flips me onto my back.
An arrow pins my shell to the ground.
Magic numbs my claws.
No tide and I've nothing to eat.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面上，我浑身一颤。
lines.en: Lightning hits the water and I jerk all over.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有沙，我扒不住。
lines.en: No sand in the void; nothing to grip.
